## 📞 Campaign dispatcher
CRM (or cascade/retry) → **one outbound batch** on the voice platform.

1. Normalize + E.164 + dedupe
2. Deterministic A/B split, arm written back to CRM
3. **Live eligibility re-check** right before dialling
4. Real calendar slots only (booking campaigns)
5. Submit batch, then hand off to the silent-failure sweeper
